segments.text: I've always found music to be the best way to unwind after a long day.
I like to listen to music when I want to relax.
It helps me switch off from everything, whether I'm lying on the couch or taking a walk in the park.
I usually go for something soft and calming, like acoustic or classical music.
It's my way of de-stressing and escaping from all the noise of everyday life.
I just close my eyes and the music takes me away.
